$schema_note: EmberbirdOS guest-base pinned-manifest evidence record. Machine-readable anchor for the review-M1 exit criterion #1 (a specific arcadia-x86 manifest SHA recorded in image/manifest/). Human-readable companion: image/manifest/README.md.

resolution.note: The manifest tree was NOT synced and NO Android image was built. Only the manifest-repository ref was resolved to a commit SHA (a read-only network query).

scope.what_this_pins: The BlissRoms-x86/manifest repository at the exact commit its arcadia-x86 branch pointed to on 2026-04-12 (branch head, and the repo's default HEAD, as observed 2026-09-23).
scope.what_this_does_NOT_pin: The per-project component revisions. The default manifest at this commit still references many component projects by branch/tag rather than by SHA. A fully-resolved, per-project revision lock is produced at M2 build time via `repo manifest -r -o pinned.xml` after `repo sync`, and will be committed alongside this file as arcadia-x86.pinned.xml.
scope.deferred_to: M2 (Guest Boot Proof) — repo sync + `repo manifest -r` full per-project revision lock.

gsi_plan_b.status: Plan-B, DOWNGRADED to a bring-up build effort — NOT a drop-in image (plain GSI hits signal-6/FirstStageMount in vanilla QEMU; needs the AGP boot layer + -cpu host). Tracked as the clean-license rebase target in the M6 band.

build_variant.reason: GMS-free by default; GApps user-supplied. See docs/M1-RUNTIME-ARCHITECTURE.md #6.
